yuri 0.3-3
  • Reference

    Get a data set

    dataURI.Rd

    Download the files associated with a URI and return the filenames.

    dataURI(uri, path, cache=TRUE, unzip=TRUE, recursive=FALSE, filter=TRUE, username=NULL, password=NULL, institute=NULL, email=NULL)

    Arguments

    uri

    character. The URI of a dataset

    path

    character. The path to where the data should be saved. The simplified uri is always appended to this path

    cache

    logical. if TRUE the data are only downloaded again if they are not locally available

    unzip

    logical. if TRUE downloaded zip files are unzipped

    recursive

    logical. if TRUE also return filenames in sub-directories

    filter

    logical. if TRUE files that probably do not have the primary data are filtered out (files ending on .pdf, .doc(x), .json)

    username

    optional. For Dataverse guestbooks, used as the name field when given; for Dryad, the OAuth client id. If NULL or empty, the value is taken from credentials registered via authenticate (DATAVERSE$name), then environment variables YURI_DATAVERSE_USERNAME / DATAVERSE_GUESTBOOK_NAME, then a built-in default.

    password

    optional. For Dataverse, treated as an API token if set (X-Dataverse-key); if not given, the token registered via authenticate (DATAVERSE$token) or the environment variables YURI_DATAVERSE_PASSWORD, DATAVERSE_API_TOKEN, or DATAVERSE_KEY are used. For Dryad, the OAuth client secret.

    institute

    optional. For Dataverse guestbooks, the institution field. If NULL or empty, the value is taken from credentials registered via authenticate (DATAVERSE$institution), then YURI_DATAVERSE_INSTITUTE / DATAVERSE_GUESTBOOK_INSTITUTION, then a built-in default.

    email

    optional. For Dataverse guestbooks, the email field. If NULL or empty, the value is taken from credentials registered via authenticate (DATAVERSE$email), then YURI_DATAVERSE_EMAIL / DATAVERSE_GUESTBOOK_EMAIL, then a built-in default.

    Details

    Some Harvard Dataverse (and other Dataverse) datasets require a guestbook before bulk file download. In that case, dataURI POSTs to the Dataverse Access API with signed=true and a guestbook payload, then downloads via the returned signed URL (see the Data Access API guide).

    Guestbook field resolution order is: function arguments (username for name, email, institute, password for API token), then credentials registered via authenticate (DATAVERSE$<field>), then environment variables (YURI_DATAVERSE_* and the historical DATAVERSE_GUESTBOOK_*), then built-in defaults.

    Register the fields the server requires with authenticate(list(DATAVERSE = list(name, email, institution, position, token, answers))) (use GET /api/guestbooks/{id} to inspect what the server asks for).

    Custom guestbook questions must be supplied in answers as a list of lists with id and value elements (see Dataverse API examples).

    Value

    character, the downloaded file names
